designed_after: notebook 41 (greedy deletion path) results were known

estimands.event_weighted: mean of AUC_e over events with at least one pre-onset minute
estimands.minute_weighted: sum_e n_e AUC_e / sum_e n_e (n_e pre-onset minutes of e) = the per-minute pre-onset AUC of Tables 3 and 6
estimands.per_event: AUC_e = Pr{s(pre-onset minute of event e) > s(negative minute)} + 1/2 Pr{tie}, negatives common to all events
estimands.within_regime: same with pairs counted only inside RV deciles (per-event within-regime AUC, then the mean)

guards: notebook-22 per-minute AUCs; notebook-33 GBM - M0 points; unit calculator with unit weights equals make_parts/stats_from; minute-weighted mean of per-event AUCs equals the per-minute AUC; notebook-41 all-event pre-onset block and event intervals reproduced with the notebook-41 draws
inputs: spot cache, notebook-2 catalog, notebook-16 frozen models; stored results of notebooks 22, 33 and 41 for guards; holdouts and the prospective folder not read

intervals.block: 2000 draws of 7-day blocks (seed 20261145 + 1), shared by both systems; event weight = mean block multiplicity of its pre-onset minutes
intervals.event_a: 2000 draws: all events of the definition resampled with replacement (seed 20261145 + 100 + H), negatives fixed; event weight = multiplicity

minutes: notebook-33 common minutes (valid, finite M0, M1, GBM, B0 scores, RV decile assigned, evaluation period)

readings.R1: H=1440 GBM - M0 event-weighted pre-onset AUC: block and event intervals both below zero -> M0 lead holds with equal event weights; both above -> GBM ahead with equal event weights; otherwise not distinguishable with equal event weights (the per-minute lead rests on weighting by pre-onset minutes)
readings.R2: H=1440: number of events with pre-onset minutes in which M0 AUC_e exceeds GBM AUC_e (descriptive; events are not independent); five largest contributions to minute-weighted minus event-weighted difference
readings.R3: H=1440 event-weighted within-regime pre-onset difference: rule of R1 (secondary)
readings.R4: H=240: M0 event-weighted pre-onset AUC and GBM - M0 event-weighted difference (descriptive)
readings.R5: H=1440: leave-one-event-out range of the event-weighted difference (descriptive)
readings.undetermined: an interval with a non-finite end or fewer than 95% finite draws is undetermined; fewer than 5 events with pre-onset minutes -> not interpretable

status: exploratory; post hoc; development sample only; no confirmatory plan changed
title: Event-weighted pre-onset AUC: is the 24-hour M0 pre-onset lead a product of minute weighting? (exploratory, post hoc; development sample)
